text:
claire: heads up—my YAML just self-tagged as `version: v2.0-therapy` and left a sticky note: 'please be gentle with my whitespace'. :pleading_face:
diego: omg mine added `# learning to love semver` to the top of the file. config files are now sentient. :laughing:
build-bot: Lint result: config.yml:7: mixed indentation detected. Advice: supply snacks and reassurance.
anya: poll time: would you rather diagnose an off-by-one bug or unravel a YAML with hidden tabs? :one: off-by-one :two: hidden tabs
claire: :two: hidden tabs haunt dreams. at least off-by-one has a stack trace.
diego: commit message i made today: "fix: apologize to YAML for previous aggression" with diff:
```diff
-	indented: wrong
+  indented: sincere
```
anya: note for new hires: if the coffee machine starts offering merge strategies, do not accept. :coffee:
build-bot: Reminder: run `make lint-yaml` and don't trust `version: latest` in prod.
claire: summary emoji: :coffee: :bug: :white_check_mark:
